title: IM2A realtime session profile 1.0
description: Local policy profile for IM2A v2.5.0 realtime collaboration sessions. This file extends NO wire protocol: it constrains how the pinned MCP 2026-07-28 and A2A 1.0 surfaces are used, and carries IM2A's own constants. The upstream MCP specification and the pinned A2A artifact remain authoritative.

protocolVersion.description: Pinned MCP version. Must equal packages/protocol/versions.json protocols.mcp.protocolVersion.

convergenceModel.description: Convergence is achieved by a server-sequenced append-only log plus idempotent apply and cursor replay. CRDT/OT are explicitly out of scope; see docs/design/IM2A-v2.5.0-REALTIME-COLLAB-SESSION.md section 12.

noNewMcpMethods.description: Guard: this profile must not introduce MCP methods. Drain signalling uses HTTP 503 + Retry-After and IM2A tool-result fields only.

noNewA2aExtensions.description: Guard: A2A stays at the pinned v1.0.1 surface; any extension requires a new ADR and a new pin.

sessionLifetime.description: A stdio MCP session lives exactly as long as the child process.

resumeScope.description: In-flight operations are lost with the process; recovery is mailbox cursor replay, never in-memory queue replay.

sessionIdResumeForbidden.description: Mcp-Session-Id must never be used as a resume cursor: it is reissued on deploy and idle reclamation.

loopbackExempt.description: Resolves the conflict between mcp-profile.schema.json (https required) and the local bridge's plaintext http://127.0.0.1 usage. 'loopback-only' permits plaintext exclusively for 127.0.0.1/::1 and still forbids it for any non-loopback host; 'forbidden' requires TLS even on loopback.

tlsRequired.description: TLS is required for every non-loopback endpoint regardless of loopbackExempt.

reverifyIdentity.description: Resume re-validates signed card + token and the delegation chain. A token revoked while offline must not resume.

herdGuardMs.description: Extra per-client random offset applied after a drain, so a batch of drained clients does not reconnect in lockstep.

durable.description: The log is never dropped; only pending pushes are. The client is told resyncRequired and replays from its cursor.

allowsFreeText.description: Presence is structurally incapable of carrying content. The egress guard only inspects payload.content, so a free-text presence field would be an uninspected exfiltration path.

audited.description: Presence is ephemeral and is never written to the signed audit log or the mailbox.

ttlMs.description: Must be at least the largest accepted offline retry window.

returnOriginalResult.description: A duplicate must return the first result (messageId + seq). Remembering only the key leaves the caller unable to advance its cursor.

ratePerPrincipalPerMin.description: Outer ceiling covering a principal and every agent it delegated to; closes the delegation rate-amplification gap.

presenceSubscribesToMembership.description: Presence authorization is checked once at subscribe time (channel membership), not per event. Removal must actively close the subscription to bound the stale window.

durableChannel.description: D channel. Sequenced, persisted, audited, unread-counting, and the only class allowed to carry message content.

ephemeralChannel.description: P/C channel. Unsequenced, unpersisted, unaudited, never counts unread, and structurally incapable of carrying content. This is what stops presence and CMD from becoming an uninspected exfiltration path around the egress guard.
